defect: The v26 DDL issued ROLLBACK before the v26 functions and triggers. Executing the file erased every base table before the new functions referenced them.
correction: Moved the single rollback to the final statement and added a transaction-finality static gate.

defect: Component closure joined p3_component_connectivity_edge through a nonexistent pair_fact_id rather than its projection_id.
correction: Rewired component closure through p3_pair_projection to the governing pair fact and projected endpoints.

defect: Internal-pair closure referenced nonexistent direct_pair_fact_id and therefore could not validate projection-backed direct relations.
correction: Rewired closure through direct_pair_projection_id while preserving directional source roles and unordered candidate-pair storage.

defect: The DDL added a foreign key on p3_lineage_disposition.candidate_family_id even though the column had been removed to permit overlapping candidate participation.
correction: Removed the impossible foreign key and retained candidate participation in the many-to-many candidate membership surface.

defect: Read-only validation queries used removed columns, old vocabulary codes, and the wrong canonical revision identifier.
correction: Corrected all stale joins, fields, role codes, and proposed-member pair counts; added v7 closure queries.

defect: JSON required an immutable origin_key but PostgreSQL persistence omitted it.
correction: Persisted a nonzero SHA-256 origin key with release-scoped uniqueness.

defect: Candidate event JSON required occurred_at while SQL omitted it and could not enforce temporal order.
correction: Persisted occurred_at and required strictly increasing event time and contiguous event ordinal.

defect: Candidate-origin, adjudication-partition, split, and canonical-promotion assertions existed but no trigger or release query invoked them.
correction: Added deferred constraint triggers that execute every closure assertion against the final transaction state.

defect: The generic member partition ignored split-result treatment, so a schema-valid complete split always failed semantic validation.
correction: Made split-result membership a terminal disposition category and added a valid split fixture plus disjoint-cover tests.

defect: Hierarchy-only validation counted only narrower endpoints; a valid broader/narrower pair failed, while accepted members could be smuggled into hierarchy-only status.
correction: Defined hierarchy disposition as the union of governed broader and narrower candidate endpoints and prohibited incompatible status mixtures.

defect: Members could occupy more than one terminal decision category under mixed child structures.
correction: Enforced pairwise-disjoint terminal category sets whose union equals the candidate membership exactly.

defect: The serialization contract had stale V5 identities and no executable NFC, line-ending, set-order, duplicate, or numeric rules.
correction: Delivered p3_canonical_json_v7.py, executable vectors, NFC/LF normalization, set sorting, duplicate rejection, and float rejection.

defect: The evidence hash covered selected IDs and nested hash strings rather than the full delivered evidence. Mutated semantic content could survive when its nested content_hash was left unchanged.
correction: Hash the full nonrecursive delivered evidence surface, including complete signatures, response references, components, projections, pair matrix, variants, exclusions, and context.

defect: Nested packet objects could cite a different authority release from the candidate and decision.
correction: Recursively require every delivered authority_release_id to equal the packet release before adjudication.

defect: JSON Schema date-time declarations were validated without a FormatChecker, so malformed timestamps passed.
correction: Use jsonschema FormatChecker for every schema validation and add a malformed-date mutation.

defect: Packets carried component IDs but not the component records needed to reconstruct candidate origin and membership.
correction: Added origin_components to the packet and require exact reconstruction from component members plus attachment projections.

defect: Variant and exclusion promotions were not proven to map every and only delivered candidate object; rule-based exclusions could fabricate named members.
correction: Require exact candidate-to-canonical promotion mappings, exact member partitions, owner coherence, and zero named members for rule-based exclusions.

defect: Static tests searched for reassuring strings but missed impossible SQL, stale schema names, stale vocabularies, and the V650/V651/V652 runtime-command typo.
correction: Added a table/column-aware static SQL closure checker, corrected internal-pair schema and vocabularies, restored V550J/V551J/V552J names, and mutation-tested the checker.
